lead_intro: Learn about the Iron Curtain and the construction of walls in Europe after World War II.

quiz.question: What was the main objective of the Iron Curtain separating the Soviet Camp from the Western Camp?
choices: Preventing migration from east to west
quiz.answer: Preventing migration from east to west
quiz.explanation: The main objective of the Iron Curtain was to prevent migration from east to west.

quiz.question: How wide is the zone forbidden to the population on the eastern side of the Iron Curtain?
quiz.explanation: A zone up to five kilometers wide was forbidden to the population on the eastern side of the Iron Curtain.

quiz.question: What was there on the western side of the Iron Curtain that was about 10 meters wide?
choices: A strip without construction or vegetation
A strip of shops and markets
A strip of parks and gardens
quiz.answer: A strip without construction or vegetation
quiz.explanation: On the western side of the Iron Curtain, there was a strip about 10 meters wide without construction or vegetation.

quiz.question: How were the borders finally closed in the construction of the Iron Curtain?
quiz.explanation: The borders were finally closed by a barbed wire fence in the construction of the Iron Curtain.

quiz.question: What was one feature of the barbed wire fence that closed the borders in the Iron Curtain construction?
quiz.explanation: One feature of the barbed wire fence was that it could be electrified in the Iron Curtain construction.
